svg.title: Scene 63: Interference: H, then Z, then H always gives 1
svg.desc: Five frames. 1, a circuit: ket 0, an H gate, a Z gate, another H gate, then a measurement. 2, the amplitudes after each step: ket 0 is 1 and 0; after H, plus 0.707 and plus 0.707; after Z, plus 0.707 and minus 0.707; after the last H, 0 and 1. 3, the last H path by path: to output 0, plus 0.5 from the ket 0 part and minus 0.5 from the ket 1 part cancel to 0; to output 1, plus 0.5 and plus 0.5 add to 1. 4, for a general phase phi between the parts, the final probabilities are cos squared of phi over 2 for 0 and sin squared of phi over 2 for 1, plotted from 0 to 360 degrees with values 1, 0.5, 0, 0.5 and 1 for P of 0 at 0, 90, 180, 270 and 360 degrees. 5, phi equal to 180 degrees is the Z gate, so this circuit reads 1 every time.
svg.text: Paths to the wrong answer cancel; paths to the
right one add. That is all interference means

g.text: The last H, path by path
